Spells (Knave 1e).name: Spells (Knave 1e)
Spells (Knave 1e).description:
“L” is a number equal to the caster’s level, an item is an object able to be lifted with one hand, and an object is anything up to human size. Unless otherwise noted, all spells with ongoing effects last up to L×10 minutes, and have a range of up to 40 feet. If a spell directly affects another creature, the creature may make a save to avoid it. Success reduces or negates the spell’s effects.

From Knave (first edition) by Ben Milton, licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

1-1.name: Adhere
1-1.description: Object is covered in extremely sticky slime.

2-2.name: Animate Object
2-2.description: Object obeys your commands as best it can. It can walk 15ft per round.

3-3.name: Anthropomorphize
3-3.description: A touched animal either gains human intelligence or human appearance for L days.

4-4.name: Arcane Eye
4-4.description: You can see through a magical floating eyeball that flies around at your command.

5-5.name: Astral Prison
5-5.description: An object is frozen in time and space within an invulnerable crystal shell.

6-6.name: Attract
6-6.description: L+1 objects are strongly magnetically attracted to each other if they come within 10 feet.

7-7.name: Auditory Illusion
7-7.description: You create illusory sounds that seem to come from a direction of your choice.

8-8.name: Babble
8-8.description: A creature must loudly and clearly repeat everything you think. It is otherwise mute.

9-9.name: Beast Form
9-9.description: You and your possessions transform into a mundane animal.

10-10.name: Befuddle
10-10.description: L creatures of your choice are unable to form new short-term memories for the duration of the spell.

11-11.name: Bend Fate
11-11.description: Roll L+1 d20s. Whenever you must roll a d20 after casting the spell, you must choose and then discard one of the rolled results until they are all gone.

12-12.name: Bird Person
12-12.description: Your arms turn into huge bird wings.

13-13.name: Body Swap
13-13.description: You switch bodies with a creature you touch. If one body dies, the other dies as well.

14-14.name: Catherine
14-14.description: A woman wearing a blue dress appears until end of spell. She will obey polite, safe requests.

15-15.name: Charm
15-15.description: L creatures treat you like a friend.

16-16.name: Command
16-16.description: A creature obeys a single, three-word command that does not harm it.

17-17.name: Comprehend
17-17.description: You become fluent in all languages.

18-18.name: Control Plants
18-18.description: Nearby plants and trees obey you and gain the ability to move at 5 feet per round.

19-19.name: Control Weather
19-19.description: You may alter the type of weather at will, but you do not otherwise control it.

20-20.name: Counterspell
20-20.description: Make an opposed Intelligence save against the Intelligence of the caster of a nearby spell. You may do this out of turn as a reaction, or against an ongoing magical effect. On a success, you may cancel the spell.

22-22.name: Detect Magic
22-22.description: You hear nearby magical auras singing. Volume and harmony signify the aura’s power and refinement.

23-23.name: Disassemble
23-23.description: Any of your body parts may be detached and reattached at will, without causing pain or damage. You can still control them.

24-24.name: Disguise
24-24.description: You may alter the appearance of L characters at will as long as they remain humanoid. Attempts to duplicate other characters will seem uncanny.

25-25.name: Displace
25-25.description: An object appears to be up to L×10ft from its actual position.

26-26.name: Earthquake
26-26.description: The ground begins shaking violently. Structures may be damaged or collapse.

27-27.name: Elasticity
27-27.description: Your body can stretch up to L×10ft.

28-28.name: Elemental Wall
28-28.description: A straight wall of ice or fire L×40ft long and 10ft high rises from the ground.

29-29.name: Filch
29-29.description: L visible items teleport to your hands.

30-30.name: Fog Cloud
30-30.description: Dense fog spreads out from you.

31-31.name: Frenzy
31-31.description: L creatures erupt in a frenzy of violence.

32-32.name: Gate
32-32.description: A portal to a random plane opens.

33-33.name: Gravity Shift
33-33.description: You can change the direction of gravity (for yourself only) up to once per round.

34-34.name: Greed
34-34.description: L creatures develop an overwhelming urge to possess a visible item of your choice.

36-36.name: Hatred
36-36.description: L creatures develop a deep hatred of another creature or group of creatures and wish to destroy it.

37-37.name: Hear Whispers
37-37.description: You can hear faint sounds clearly.

38-38.name: Hover
38-38.description: An object hovers, frictionless, 2ft above the ground. It can hold up to L humanoids.

39-39.name: Hypnotize
39-39.description: A creature enters a trance and will truthfully answer L yes or no questions you ask it.

40-40.name: Icy Touch
40-40.description: A thick ice layer spreads across a touched surface, up to L×10ft in radius.

41-41.name: Illuminate
41-41.description: A floating light moves as you command.

42-42.name: Increase Gravity
42-42.description: The gravity in an area triples.

43-43.name: Invisible Tether
43-43.description: Two objects within 10ft of each other cannot be moved more than 10ft apart.

44-44.name: Knock
44-44.description: L nearby mundane or magical locks unlock.

45-45.name: Leap
45-45.description: You can jump up to L×10ft in the air.

46-46.name: Liquid Air
46-46.description: The air around you becomes swimmable.

47-47.name: Magic Dampener
47-47.description: All nearby magical effects have their effectiveness halved.

48-48.name: Manse
48-48.description: A sturdy, furnished cottage appears for L×12 hours. You can permit and forbid entry to it at will.

49-49.name: Marble Madness
49-49.description: Your pockets are full of marbles, and will refill every round.

50-50.name: Masquerade
50-50.description: L characters’ appearances and voices become identical to a touched character.

51-51.name: Miniaturize
51-51.description: You and L other touched creatures are reduced to the size of a mouse.

52-52.name: Mirror Image
52-52.description: L illusory duplicates of yourself appear under your control.

53-53.name: Mirrorwalk
53-53.description: A mirror becomes a gateway to another mirror that you looked into today.

55-55.name: Night Sphere
55-55.description: An L×40ft wide sphere of darkness displaying the night sky appears.

56-56.name: Objectify
56-56.description: You become any inanimate object between the size of a grand piano and an apple.

58-58.name: Pacify
58-58.description: L creatures have an aversion to violence.

59-59.name: Phantom Coach
59-59.description: A ghostly coach appears until end of spell. It moves unnaturally fast over any terrain, including water.

60-60.name: Phobia
60-60.description: L creatures become terrified of an object of your choice.

61-61.name: Pit
61-61.description: A pit 10ft wide and L×5ft deep opens in the ground.

62-62.name: Primeval Surge
62-62.description: An object grows to the size of an elephant. If it is an animal, it is enraged.

63-63.name: Psychometry
63-63.description: The referee answers L yes or no questions about a touched object.

64-64.name: Pull
64-64.description: An object of any size is pulled directly towards you with the strength of L men for one round.

65-65.name: Push
65-65.description: An object of any size is pushed directly away from you with the strength of L men for one round.

66-66.name: Raise Dead
66-66.description: L skeletons rise from the ground to serve you. They are incredibly stupid and can only obey simple orders.

67-67.name: Raise Spirit
67-67.description: The spirit of a dead body manifests and will answer L questions.

68-68.name: Read Mind
68-68.description: You can hear the surface thoughts of nearby creatures.

69-69.name: Repel
69-69.description: L+1 objects are strongly magnetically repelled from each other if they come within 10 feet.

70-70.name: Scry
70-70.description: You can see through the eyes of a creature you touched earlier today.

71-71.name: Sculpt Elements
71-71.description: All inanimate material behaves like clay in your hands.

72-72.name: Shroud
72-72.description: L creatures are invisible until they move.

73-73.name: Shuffle
73-73.description: L creatures instantly switch places. Determine where they end up randomly.

74-74.name: Sleep
74-74.description: L creatures fall into a light sleep.

76-76.name: Snail Knight
76-76.description: 10 minutes after casting, a knight sitting astride a giant snail rides into view. He is able to answer most questions related to quests and chivalry, and may aid you if he finds you worthy.

77-77.name: Sniff
77-77.description: You can smell even the faintest traces of scents.

78-78.name: Sort
78-78.description: Inanimate items sort themselves according to categories you set. The categories must be visually verifiable.

79-79.name: Spectacle
79-79.description: A clearly unreal but impressive illusion of your choice appears, under your control. It may be up to the size of a palace and has full motion and sound.

80-80.name: Spellseize
80-80.description: Cast this as a reaction to another spell going off to make a temporary copy of it that you can cast at any time before this spell ends.

81-81.name: Spider Climb
81-81.description: You can climb surfaces like a spider.

82-82.name: Summon Cube
82-82.description: Once per second, (6 times per round) you may summon or banish a 3-foot-wide cube of earth. New cubes must be affixed to the earth or to other cubes.

83-83.name: Swarm
83-83.description: You become a swarm of crows, rats, or piranhas. You only take damage from area effects.

84-84.name: Telekinesis
84-84.description: You may mentally move L items.

85-85.name: Telepathy
85-85.description: L+1 creatures can hear each other’s thoughts, no matter how far apart they move.

86-86.name: Teleport
86-86.description: An object disappears and reappears on the ground in a visible, clear area up to L×40ft away.

87-87.name: Thaumaturgic Anchor
87-87.description: Object becomes the target of every spell cast near it.

88-88.name: Thicket
88-88.description: A thicket of trees and dense brush up to L×40ft wide suddenly sprouts up.

89-89.name: Time Jump
89-89.description: An object disappears as it jumps L×10 minutes into the future. When it returns, it appears in the unoccupied area nearest to where it left.

90-90.name: Summon Idol
90-90.description: A carved stone statue the size of a four poster bed rises from the ground.

91-91.name: Time Rush
91-91.description: Time in a 40ft bubble starts moving 10 times faster.

92-92.name: Time Slow
92-92.description: Time in a 40ft bubble slows to 10%.

93-93.name: True Sight
93-93.description: You see through all nearby illusions.

95-95.name: Vision
95-95.description: You completely control what a creature sees.

96-96.name: Visual Illusion
96-96.description: A silent, immobile, illusion of your choice appears, up to the size of a bedroom.

97-97.name: Ward
97-97.description: A silver circle 40ft across appears on the ground. Choose one thing that cannot cross it: Living creatures, dead creatures, projectiles or metal.

98-98.name: Web
98-98.description: Your wrists can shoot thick webbing.

99-99.name: Wizard Mark
99-99.description: Your finger can shoot a stream of ulfire-colored paint. This paint is only visible to you, and can be seen at any distance, even through solid objects.
